# manual case: clang HLSL front end on Compiler Explorer (hlsl_clang_trunk)
# why manual: not a dxc invocation, so triage.py run cannot capture it.
# harness: ce-probe.py, which calls triage.py's own ce_compile.
# re-run:
#   python ce-probe.py hlsl_clang_trunk repro.hlsl "-T ps_6_0 -E main -fsyntax-only -fno-color-diagnostics"
#
# WHY -fsyntax-only, AND THE CONTROL THAT FORCED IT (SKILL.md step 7):
#   clang's DXIL backend cannot yet lower a pixel shader writing SV_Target, so
#   without -fsyntax-only EVERY shader here fails -- including the known-good
#   control. Case 4 below is that control run without the flag: it fails with
#   "Unsupported intrinsic llvm.dx.store.output.v4f32 for DXIL lowering", which
#   has nothing to do with #2530. Case 3 is the same control WITH the flag and
#   exits 0, so under -fsyntax-only the difference between the repro and the
#   control does survive, and the clang diagnostic in cases 1 and 2 is about
#   the constant expression rather than about the shader stage.
# why -fno-color-diagnostics: CE returns ANSI-coloured text, which is
#   unreadable once captured to a file. It changes no compile result -- case 1
#   was first captured without it and is character-identical otherwise.
# expect: 1 error, 2 error, 3 clean (exit 0), 4 error-for-an-unrelated-reason
# note: hlsl_clang_trunk is a rolling build; treat the wording as current, not
#   as a fixed property of clang.
# captured: 2026-08-06T20:20:29Z

=== case 1: the repro (issue case 1) ===
$ [compiler-explorer] hlsl_clang_trunk -T ps_6_0 -E main -fsyntax-only -fno-color-diagnostics  (repro.hlsl)
[exit] 1
--- output ---
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-Qembed_debug' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-S' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
<source>:7:17: warning: variable length arrays in C++ are a Clang extension [-Wvla-cxx-extension]
    7 |     float array[uint(ARRAY_SIZE)] = { 1.0f };
      |                 ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
<source>:7:22: note: read of non-constexpr variable 'ARRAY_SIZE' is not allowed in a constant expression
    7 |     float array[uint(ARRAY_SIZE)] = { 1.0f };
      |                      ^
<source>:3:20: note: declared here
    3 | static const float ARRAY_SIZE = 1;
      |                    ^
<source>:7:16: error: variable length arrays are not supported for the current target
    7 |     float array[uint(ARRAY_SIZE)] = { 1.0f };
      |                ^
<source>:7:11: warning: variable length array folded to constant array as an extension [-Wgnu-folding-constant]
    7 |     float array[uint(ARRAY_SIZE)] = { 1.0f };
      |           ^
2 warnings and 1 error generated.
<Compilation failed>

=== case 2: issue case 2 ===
$ [compiler-explorer] hlsl_clang_trunk -T ps_6_0 -E main -fsyntax-only -fno-color-diagnostics  (case2.hlsl)
[exit] 1
--- output ---
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-Qembed_debug' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-S' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
<source>:9:17: warning: variable length arrays in C++ are a Clang extension [-Wvla-cxx-extension]
    9 |     float array[ARRAY_SIZE_UINT] = { 1.0f };
      |                 ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
<source>:9:17: note: initializer of 'ARRAY_SIZE_UINT' is not a constant expression
<source>:5:19: note: declared here
    5 | static const uint ARRAY_SIZE_UINT = (uint)ARRAY_SIZE;
      |                   ^
<source>:9:16: error: variable length arrays are not supported for the current target
    9 |     float array[ARRAY_SIZE_UINT] = { 1.0f };
      |                ^
<source>:9:11: warning: variable length array folded to constant array as an extension [-Wgnu-folding-constant]
    9 |     float array[ARRAY_SIZE_UINT] = { 1.0f };
      |           ^
2 warnings and 1 error generated.
<Compilation failed>

=== case 3: CONTROL, known-good shader, same flags -- must be clean ===
$ [compiler-explorer] hlsl_clang_trunk -T ps_6_0 -E main -fsyntax-only -fno-color-diagnostics  (control-uint-bound.hlsl)
[exit] 0
--- output ---
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-Qembed_debug' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-S' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
<No output file>

=== case 4: same CONTROL without -fsyntax-only -- shows why the flag is needed ===
$ [compiler-explorer] hlsl_clang_trunk -T ps_6_0 -E main -fno-color-diagnostics  (control-uint-bound.hlsl)
[exit] 1
--- output ---
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-Qembed_debug' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
error: Unsupported intrinsic llvm.dx.store.output.v4f32 for DXIL lowering
1 error generated.
<Compilation failed>
